title: (MZ) Any Astronaut or Space Suit side view battlers?

posts.author: OldSchoolFool
posts.body:
I've looked around on Steam, Itch, and using Google, but I can't seem to find some animation sets to use as side view player battlers like this.  I've looked for sprites and for character generator DLC.  Does anybody know of anything like this, which fit the 9 image by 6 image character generator "battler" generator built into RPG Maker MZ?
The game I'm creating now will have almost all of its battles take place while the player is in a space suit, so I hope I can have the visuals on-screen reflect that.  Thanks if anyone can point me in the right direction.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
